Name: Faust the Gravekeeper - Custom NPC
Author: SukuroIsUseless
Description:
[center][b][size=3]Custom NPC Mod For Some Guy I Made[/size][/b][/center]
[center][i]Feedback appreciated, as always!
[/i][size=3][b]I still do not have access to his 3.0.0 files[/b] [/size][size=2]because of my broken storage device, but I can finally mod him again using the files that were uploaded here, so [/size][size=3][b]I can do bugfixes[/b].[/size][size=2] (I can also do the download milestone arts again- not that anybody cared.) But, until I can get my storage device fixed, [/size][size=3][u]the 3.0.0 update for Faust is still on indefinite hiatus.[/u][/size][size=2] If I can't get it fixed, I will sadly have to abandon him, because I won't be able to recover any of the files I need, and I do not have the drive to restart everything. Given how long it has been broken, I'm losing hope, but there is still a chance I can get it fixed. 🙏 (And if I do get the 3.0.0 files back, I'm gonna have to recode all the changes I do here in the meantime, so let's hope there's not too many.)[/size][/center]


[center][/center]
Faust is a gloomy young man who cares for the cemeteries in Pelican Town. Ever since he moved in, the only company he surrounds himself with is that of the ﻿graves he tends to. Though he holds no social relationships with any of the townsfolk, his loneliness seems to be self-inflicted. But by talking to him and throwing two ﻿gifts a week at him, maybe [i]you[/i] can get him to open up!



Because he lives up at the railroad, you [b]will not be able to interact with him[/b] [s]until the landslide clears on the 3rd of Summer.[/s] until you visit the railroad for the first time, and wait until the day after.

[u]If you notice any bugs, spelling mistakes, missing punctuation, or conflicting dialogue, please let me know![/u]

[size=3][u][b][i]One of his Heart Events contains mentions of suicidal thoughts. Just thought I should put a warning for that.[/i][/b][/u] [/size][size=2](Since it's just mentions and not that major of a thing, I'm not adding the NSFW tag cause I don't want him getting lumped together with all the gross NSFW mods 💀)[/size]

[center][size=2]~~[/size][/center]

This mod was initially made to require [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url], but no longer requires it. I would still recommend it if you want the intended experience or whatever, but you do you!

﻿Having the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Cute Characters[/url] mod is recommended, since the style of his sprites are based around those + he has seasonal outfits.

[center]﻿~~[/center]
[center][/center]
This Mod Adds:
[list]
[*][size=3][b][i]One new NPC - Faust![/i][/b][/size][/*]
[/list][size=2]  ﻿His dialogue, sprites, and portraits were all made by me.
﻿He even has seasonal outfits, plus one festival outfit so far![/size]

[list]
[*][size=3][b][i]Events![/i][/b][/size][/*]
[/list]  [size=2]Currently, Faust has his all of his Heart Events- [/size][b]excluding[/b][size=2] his 14 Heart Event- along with a 5 Heart Event and three extra events. His 8 Heart Event is broken up into two halves.
﻿One of his extra events is an easter egg that is only accessible if you have certain mods installed.[/size]

[list]
[*][size=3][i][b]His own house![/b][/i][/size][/*]
[/list]  [size=2]Forgot to mention that he has his own house like I did with Argenti. Oops. It's located up at the railroad, on the other side of the train tracks.
﻿There is also an option to relocate it if it conflicts with any mods. In this case, it will be put in the graveyard, at the cost of removing 1 grave.
﻿Should you not have SVE installed, his house is located on the same side of the tracks as the spa (where Susan's farm would be).[/size]

[size=3][u]NOTICE REGARDING AI:[/u] [/size][size=2]I (not-so recently anymore) discovered that someone generated AI portraits for Faust. (You know who you are.) While it's great that enough people like Faust to want AI slop of him, I don't see why you would want AI slop when there are plenty of wonderful portrait mods for him already made by [i]REAL people.[/i] Regardless of my opinions on AI, I can't stop people from generating shit of him. As long as you are making it [u]explicitly clear[/u] that you used AI and you didn't actually make shit, and aren't feeding your AI any of my work (and ESPECIALLY not the work of anyone else- their stuff is actually good compared to mine), I don't care. Would [i]love[/i] if you asked for permission first though before uploading shit. ([i]cough cough[/i] You know who you are again.)[/size]

Anyway, these can all be found in the [i]Mods requiring this file[/i] section of the [i]Requirements[/i] window, but in case you missed them, here are some lovely portrait mods made by [i]real,[/i] talented people!
